items.t: Amazon Prime and Uber Eats partnership: $0 delivery fees on $25+ orders for Prime members
items.sum: As of November 5, 2026, Amazon has partnered with Uber Eats to offer Amazon Prime members a new benefit: $0 delivery fees on qualifying orders of $25 or more.

items.t: How Investors May Respond To Amazon Stock As AWS Growth And Anthropic IPO Near

items.t: Amazon stands out as the best consumer stock pick

items.t: Amazon Joins Goldman Sachs’ Conviction List Alongside 4 Other Stock Picks
items.sum: Goldman Sachs just overhauled its Conviction List with five new additions, and the upside targets on some of these picks will raise eyebrows. One hyperscaler alone carries a 51% potential gain, but it is far from the biggest number on the list.
